name.en: Review marrow morphology and flow cytometry

en: Review marrow morphology and flow cytometry

text.zh-CN: 骨髓涂片所谓原始细胞76%，无Auer小体、POX阴性；异常群体部分表达CD15/CD117，多种血细胞谱系标志阴性，不能只据“原始”外观确诊AML。
text.en: Marrow cells labelled blasts comprised 76%, without Auer rods and with negative POX. The abnormal population partly expressed CD15/CD117 but lacked many haematopoietic lineage markers; blast-like appearance alone does not establish AML.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

name.zh-CN: 调阅骨髓活检及免疫组化

zh-CN: 调阅骨髓活检及免疫组化

text.zh-CN: 造血组织减少，大量癌细胞浸润；AE1/AE3、CAM5.2、Syn阳性，MPO及LCA阴性，TTF1阴性，Ki-67约30%。病理符合小细胞神经内分泌癌。
text.en: Reduced haematopoietic tissue with extensive carcinoma infiltration; AE1/AE3, CAM5.2 and synaptophysin positive, MPO/LCA and TTF1 negative, Ki-67 about 30%. Pathology was consistent with small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma.

text.zh-CN: 左肺门占位及纵隔淋巴结增大；早期普通胸片曾正常。
text.en: Left hilar mass and enlarged mediastinal nodes; an earlier plain chest film had been normal.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: PET-CT显示左上肺近肺门1.6×2.9 cm结节SUVmax 5.6，肺门/锁骨上淋巴结及骨髓摄取增高；NSE 250.4 μg/L、ProGRP>5000 ng/L。未取得肺灶直接病理。
text.en: PET-CT showed a left upper perihilar 1.6×2.9 cm nodule with SUVmax 5.6 and increased hilar/supraclavicular nodal and marrow uptake. NSE was 250.4 μg/L and ProGRP >5000 ng/L. Direct lung-lesion histology was not obtained.

name.en: Review pancreatic enzymes and abdominal imaging

en: Review pancreatic enzymes and abdominal imaging

text.zh-CN: 脂肪酶1686–2086 U/L、淀粉酶216–264 U/L，腹部影像无胰腺明显异常，缺乏本次典型胰腺炎疼痛。血尿渗透压及尿钠未完善，SIADH仅为临床考虑。
text.en: Lipase 1686–2086 U/L and amylase 216–264 U/L, without clear pancreatic imaging abnormalities or typical acute pancreatitis pain this episode. Serum/urine osmolality and urine sodium were not obtained; SIADH was a clinical possibility.

text.zh-CN: 确诊后转肿瘤科当日突发发热、呼吸困难和Ⅰ型呼吸衰竭，右肺大片影被考虑出血或感染。支持治疗后仍进展；进一步抢救终止，随访获悉转运途中死亡。未记录开始肿瘤特异治疗，也未证实肺部急变的唯一机制。
text.en: On the day of oncology transfer after diagnosis, fever, dyspnoea and type I respiratory failure developed, with extensive right-lung opacities considered haemorrhage or infection. Deterioration continued despite support; further resuscitation ended and death in transit was reported. Tumour-specific therapy and a single confirmed mechanism of the pulmonary deterioration are not documented.

text.zh-CN: 骨髓转移性小细胞神经内分泌癌，临床支持肺原发，肺灶未直接活检
text.en: Metastatic small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma in marrow, with a clinically supported pulmonary primary not directly biopsied

feedback.zh-CN: 形态需与免疫组化结合；肺原发推断和骨髓病理确证应分开表达。
feedback.en: Morphology requires immunohistochemical correlation; inference of a pulmonary primary must be distinguished from proven marrow pathology.

text.zh-CN: 看到大量原始样细胞即可确诊AML，忽略上皮及神经内分泌标记
text.en: Numerous blast-like cells establish AML regardless of epithelial/neuroendocrine markers

feedback.zh-CN: 形态需与免疫组化结合；肺原发推断和骨髓病理确证应分开表达。
feedback.en: Morphology requires immunohistochemical correlation; inference of a pulmonary primary must be distinguished from proven marrow pathology.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何在治疗前处理这些不一致？
prompt.en: How should discordant evidence be handled before treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先采集相关病史并调阅此阶段的关键检查。
need.en: First obtain the relevant history and retrieve the key records for this phase.

text.zh-CN: 血液、病理与肿瘤团队复核来源并支持贫血、出血及低钠；不按未证实AML直接诱导化疗
text.en: Haematology, pathology and oncology review the primary while supporting anaemia, bleeding and sodium abnormalities; do not give AML induction on an unconfirmed label

feedback.zh-CN: 胰酶和低钠需要机制评估；不完整证据不能当作独立确诊，错误谱系判断会改变治疗方向。
feedback.en: Enzyme elevation and hyponatraemia need mechanistic assessment; incomplete evidence is not confirmation, and wrong lineage assignment changes treatment direction.

text.zh-CN: 把胰酶升高和低钠分别当作已确诊胰腺炎与SIADH，直接进入AML诱导
text.en: Treat pancreatitis and SIADH as already proven and proceed with AML induction

feedback.zh-CN: 胰酶和低钠需要机制评估；不完整证据不能当作独立确诊，错误谱系判断会改变治疗方向。
feedback.en: Enzyme elevation and hyponatraemia need mechanistic assessment; incomplete evidence is not confirmation, and wrong lineage assignment changes treatment direction.

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 骨髓病理确证转移性小细胞癌，肺原发为综合临床判断；最终死亡，不能补写化疗缓解。
conclusion.en: Marrow pathology confirmed metastatic small-cell carcinoma, with pulmonary origin inferred clinically. The final outcome was death, not an unreported chemotherapy response.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: POX阴性或无Auer小体单独并不能排除所有AML；本例依赖整套免疫和组织证据。
keyReasoning.en: Negative POX or absent Auer rods alone do not exclude every AML; the full tissue and immunophenotypic pattern matters.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 低钠相关SIADH及胰酶异位分泌属于可能机制，不是本例完成检测的确证。
keyReasoning.en: SIADH and ectopic pancreatic-enzyme production are possible mechanisms, not directly confirmed in this patient.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肺灶组织学、血尿渗透压/尿钠、胰酶来源及终末呼吸衰竭机制。
unknowns.en: Lung-lesion histology, serum/urine osmolality and sodium, enzyme source and mechanism of terminal respiratory failure.
